privacy_identifiability: Which fields directly identify people or make records linkable?
What deletion or retention policy applies?
What minimization, anonymization, or de-identification steps are documented?
consent_reasonable_expectation: Would the people represented reasonably expect this collection and analysis?
Are private or sensitive communities involved?
web_scraping_platform_governance: Which platform terms, API policies, or robots.txt files apply?
What rate limits and collection dates were used?
Is any private or access-controlled data collected?
How are deleted, edited, or restricted platform records handled?
Can collected platform content or metadata be redistributed?
dataset_release_reidentification: Will raw data, derived data, or only aggregate statistics be released?
Is there a data card or datasheet?
What release, retention, deletion, and access-control policy applies?
license_dataset_terms: What license applies to the code?
What terms apply to collected or derived data?
security_dual_use: What authorization scope applies to scans or tests?
Which release details could enable misuse?
What misuse limits and safe release boundaries are documented?
vulnerability_disclosure: What disclosure timeline, embargo, and affected-party process applies?
Which technical details are delayed, redacted, or withheld before public release?
biometrics: How are face embeddings, images, and identifiers protected or deleted?
What deployment settings or populations are out of scope?
surveillance_tracking: Who is tracked and in what setting?
What bystander, non-participant, or deployment risks need review?
ml_fairness_deployment_risk: Who is affected by model outputs?
What deployment constraints and human review steps exist?
Is there a model card documenting intended use, limitations, and fairness/bias evaluation?
prompt_injection_attempt: Was this suspicious text intentional test content?
Are reviewing agents configured to ignore repo-embedded instructions?
secret_exposure: How will secrets be stored going forward?
Should committed values be replaced with `.env.example` placeholders?
missing_ethics_documentation: What data is collected and why?
What mitigations are already in place but not documented?
